command.openWebUI: Open the dsh Web UI in Browser
config.runtime.path: Path to the dsh executable. When empty, `dsh` is looked up on `PATH` (the command installed by DeepSeek Desktop, or `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`).
config.runtime.profile: dsh profile to start. Defaults to `web`, which shares models, API keys and permission presets with your own `dsh web`.
config.context.includeActiveEditor: Attach the active editor to messages by default: the selected code with line numbers when there is a selection, otherwise just the file path (dsh reads the file when it needs to). Each message can opt out with the chip above the input box.
config.ui.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language (Chinese for Chinese, English otherwise)
config.ui.fontSize: Font size (px) of the chat panel. `0` follows VS Code: the workbench font size plus 1px.
config.ui.fontFamily: Font family of the chat panel, e.g. `"Microsoft YaHei UI", sans-serif`. Empty follows the VS Code workbench font.
config.ui.codeFontFamily: Font family for code, file paths and command output in the chat panel. Empty follows `editor.fontFamily`.
config.ui.showTurnChanges: Show a changed-files card at the end of each reply. Off by default: the bar above the input box already lists the files changed in this session.
config.title: Harness Deck
container.title: Harness Deck
extension.description: A VS Code chat panel for coding agents: the built-in DeepSeek (dsh, DeepSeek Harness), or ACP agents such as Claude, oh-my-pi and CodeBuddy
capabilities.untrusted: The backend agent reads and writes files and runs commands in the workspace, so the workspace must be trusted.
config.backends: Extra backends reachable over ACP (Agent Client Protocol). DeepSeek (dsh), oh-my-pi (`omp acp`), CodeBuddy (`codebuddy --acp`) and Claude (`claude-agent-acp`) are built in; an entry with the `id` of a built-in one (`oh-my-pi`, `codebuddy`, `claude`) replaces it, for example to give the full path of the command. Each entry needs a `name` and the `command` (plus `args`) that starts the agent in ACP mode. Switch from the chat panel's "…" menu or the "Switch Backend" command.
config.backends.id: Stable id (defaults to the name). Sessions and tabs are remembered per id.
config.backends.name: Name shown in the panel, e.g. `oh-my-pi`.
config.backends.command: Executable that speaks ACP over stdio, e.g. `omp`.
config.backends.env: Extra environment variables for the agent process.
config.backends.installHint: Shown when the command cannot be found.
config.backends.singleSession: Set to `true` if the agent only streams live updates for one session per process (CodeBuddy 2.x). The agent is then restarted before sending in another session. Overrides the built-in value when the entry replaces a built-in backend.
config.backendTrace: Troubleshooting: write every ACP message exchanged with the backend (raw JSON, long ones truncated) to the "Harness Deck: Backend" output channel. Use it to check what the agent actually sent, for example whether a reply had text between tool calls. Turn it off afterwards: messages include file contents.
config.ui.palette: Text colors in the chat panel. `soft` (default) tones the theme foreground down a little so long reading is easier on the eyes; `theme` uses the theme colors as they are. High-contrast themes always use the theme colors.
